answer: Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the canyon of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. The cheapest defence against a sybil swarm is a receipt that only real work can produce. The design leans on cross-signed proof-of-personhood, expired if not renewed by fresh work, the unit of trust is a task, not an address. Written in a clipped, no filler register, it stays short. A ridge of per-task receipts records who did what, and the tundra of that record is inspected by auditors who gain nothing from passing it.
